<thought>To find the appropriate Wolff‑Kishner reduction template, I will search the template catalog for retrosynthetic templates that break a ketone (C=O) and form an alkane (C‑C). I’ll use a simple alkane SMILES (“CCC”) as the target molecule for the search.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{"molecule_smiles": "CCC", "functional_groups_broken": ["ketone"], "functional_groups_formed": ["alkane"], "limit": 5}</action_input>
